decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 2 addresses are shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — charlotte.ellis@maine.gov → Charlotte.Ellis@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Draw a closing link as the action it is
decisions.why: 1 passage ends with a paragraph holding nothing but a link — the thing the passage was leading up to. Set as running text it looks like any other link in the sentence above it. The site already has one way of drawing an action, so it takes that. The words do not change.

decisions.label: Put the content under its own heading
decisions.why: "Statutes Regarding Methods of Representation" had nothing beneath it, and the content that belongs to it was written above the heading instead of below. Nothing is added or removed; it moves under its own title.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
